user.title: Pair a Wellfed feeder
user.description:
Make an invite on a paired client (`wellfed invite --role member`, or People in the app) and paste it here within 10 minutes. Home Assistant joins as its own client; it needs no server.

A member invite lets Home Assistant feed, change the settings, the lock and the plans, and read everything. An owner invite (`--role owner`) also lets it install firmware, including older firmware, change the feeder's Wi-Fi, set the portion weight, restart the feeder and remove other clients. Give it an owner invite only if you want Home Assistant to do those things.

reauth_confirm.description: The feeder no longer knows this Home Assistant: its key was removed. Make a new invite on a paired client and paste it here. Home Assistant joins with a new key.
